sanskrit: a̱gnim ī̍ḻe pu̱rohi̍taṁ ya̱jñasya̍ de̱vam ṛ̱tvija̍m | hotā̍raṁ ratna̱dhāta̍mam ||
english: Agni I laud, the divine household-priest of the sacrifice, the seasonal officiant, the Hotṛ, the most generous bestower of treasures.

sanskrit: a̱gniḥ pūrve̍bhi̱r ṛṣi̍bhi̱r īḍyo̱ nūta̍nair u̱ta | sa de̱vām̐ eha va̍kṣati ||
english: Agni, lauded by the ancient seers and by those of today — may he convey the gods hither.

sanskrit: a̱gninā̍ ra̱yim a̍śnava̱t poṣa̍m e̱va di̱ve-di̍ve | ya̱śasa̍ṁ vī̱rava̍ttamam ||
english: Through Agni may one attain wealth and prosperity day by day — wealth glorious and abounding in heroes.

sanskrit: agne̱ yaṁ ya̱jñam a̍dhva̱raṁ vi̱śvata̍ḥ pari̱bhūr asi̍ | sa id de̱veṣu̍ gacchati ||
english: O Agni, whatever unblemished sacrifice you encompass on all sides — that one truly reaches the gods.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̍ ka̱vikra̍tuḥ sa̱tyaś ci̱traśra̍vastamaḥ | de̱vo de̱vebhi̱r ā ga̍mat ||
english: May Agni the Hotṛ, of poet-wisdom, true, most rich in varied fame, come hither as a god among the gods.

sanskrit: yad a̱ṅga dā̱śuṣe̱ tvam agne̍ bha̱draṁ ka̍ri̱ṣyasi̍ | tavet tat sa̱tyam a̍ṅgiraḥ ||
english: Whatever good, O Agni, you will bestow upon the worshipper — that is indeed your truth, O Aṅgiras.

sanskrit: upa̍ tvāgne di̱ve-di̍ve̱ doṣā̍vastar dhi̱yā va̱yam | namo̱ bhara̍nta̱ ema̍si ||
english: To you, O Agni, day by day, at the dusk and at the dawn, we come with prayer bearing homage.

sanskrit: rāja̍ntam adhva̱rāṇā̍ṁ go̱pām ṛ̱tasya̱ dīdi̍vim | vardha̍māna̱ṁ sve dame̍ ||
english: To him who reigns over the sacrifices, the guardian of ṛta who shines bright, who grows mighty in his own house —

sanskrit: sa na̍ḥ pi̱teva̍ sū̱nave 'gne̍ sūpāya̱no bha̍va | saca̍svā naḥ sva̱staye̍ ||
english: Be gracious to us, O Agni, as a father to his son. Be our companion for our well-being.

sanskrit: vāya̱v ā yā̍hi darśate̱me somā̱ ara̍ṁkṛtāḥ | teṣā̍m pāhi śru̱dhī hava̍m ||
english: O Vāyu, come here — these Soma-draughts are made ready for you, who are beautiful to behold. Drink of them; hear our invocation.

sanskrit: vāya̍ u̱kthebhi̍r jarante̱ tvām acchā̍ jari̱tāra̍ḥ | su̱taso̍mā aha̱rvida̍ḥ ||
english: O Vāyu, the praisers extol you with hymns; those praisers whose Soma is pressed, who know the days of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: vāyo̱ tava̍ prapṛñca̱tī dhenā̍ jigāti dā̱śuṣe̍ | u̱rū̱cī soma̍pītaye ||
english: O Vāyu, your abundant stream of inspiration goes forth to the worshipper, wide-ranging, for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: indra̍vāyū i̱me su̱tā upa̱ prayo̍bhi̱r ā ga̍tam | inda̍vo vām u̱śanti̱ hi ||
english: O Indra and Vāyu, these Soma-juices are pressed; come with your delights, for the Soma-drops long for you both.

sanskrit: vāya̱v indra̍ś ca cetathaḥ su̱tānā̍ṁ vājinīvasū | tāv ā yā̍ta̱m upa̍ dra̱vat ||
english: O Vāyu and Indra, you two are keen-minded for the pressed juices, O lords rich in vigour. Come swiftly, both of you.

sanskrit: vāya̱v indra̍ś ca sunva̱ta ā yā̍ta̱m upa̍ niṣkṛ̱tam | ma̱kṣv i1̱̍tthā dhi̱yā na̍rā ||
english: O Vāyu and Indra, come to the pressing of one who extracts the Soma; come quickly hither with your thought, O heroes.

sanskrit: mi̱traṁ hu̍ve pū̱tada̍kṣa̱ṁ varu̍ṇaṁ ca ri̱śāda̍sam | dhiya̍ṁ ghṛ̱tācī̱ṁ sādha̍ntā ||
english: I invoke Mitra of pure power and Varuṇa the consumer of enemies, as they accomplish the inspiration shining with ghee.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̍ mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvṛdhāv ṛtaspṛśā | kratu̍m bṛ̱hanta̍m āśāthe ||
english: Mitra and Varuṇa, who grow great by ṛta and touch ṛta — through ṛta you two attain lofty wisdom.

sanskrit: ka̱vī no̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā tuvijā̱tā u̍ru̱kṣayā̍ | dakṣa̍ṁ dadhāte a̱pasa̍m ||
english: Mitra and Varuṇa, who are seers, born of great might, dwelling in broad spaces — they two sustain active power and skill.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱ yajva̍rī̱r iṣo̱ drava̍tpāṇī̱ śubha̍s patī | puru̍bhujā cana̱syata̍m ||
english: O Aśvins, lords of beauty with swift hands, lords of sacrificial boons, who enjoy much — find pleasure in these offerings.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱ puru̍daṁsasā̱ narā̱ śavī̍rayā dhi̱yā | dhiṣṇyā̱ vana̍ta̱ṁ gira̍ḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, heroes of many wondrous deeds, with powerful thought, with minds attentive — take delight in our hymns.

sanskrit: dasrā̍ yu̱vāka̍vaḥ su̱tā nāsa̍tyā vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ | ā yā̍taṁ rudravartanī ||
english: O marvellous Nāsatyas, with your soma-draughts pressed, the sacred grass strewn — you whose chariot-tracks are those of Rudra — come hither.

sanskrit: indrā yā̍hi citrabhāno su̱tā i̱me tvā̱yave̍ḥ | aṇvī̍bhi̱s tanā̍ pū̱tāsa̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, come hither, O you of radiant splendour; these Soma-juices, pressed for you, are purified through fine filters with the Soma plant.

sanskrit: indrā yā̍hi dhi̱yeṣi̱to vipra̍jūtaḥ su̱tāva̍taḥ | upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi vā̱ghata̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, come hither, impelled by prayer, urged by the inspired singer, toward the one who has pressed the Soma, toward the sacred formulas of the sacrificer.

sanskrit: indrā yā̍hi̱ tūtu̍jāna̱ upa̱ brahmā̍ṇi harivaḥ | su̱te da̍dhiṣva na̱ś cana̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, come hither swiftly, O lord of the tawny steeds, toward our sacred formulas. At the pressing, establish your favour upon us.

sanskrit: omā̍saś carṣaṇīdhṛto̱ viśve̍ devāsa̱ ā ga̍ta | dā̱śvāṁso̍ dā̱śuṣa̍ḥ su̱tam ||
english: O Viśvedevas — all-protecting, sustaining men — come here; grant boons to the worshipper's pressed Soma.

sanskrit: viśve̍ de̱vāso̍ a̱ptura̍ḥ su̱tam ā ga̍nta̱ tūrṇa̍yaḥ | u̱srā i̍va̱ svasa̍rāṇi ||
english: O all-gods, tireless and swift, come to the pressed Soma — as the shining ones come to their own dawns.

sanskrit: viśve̍ de̱vāso̍ a̱sridha̱ ehi̍māyāso a̱druha̍ḥ | medha̍ṁ juṣanta̱ vahna̍yaḥ ||
english: O Viśvedevas, unfailing, possessed of magical power, guileless — may the bearers delight in the oblation.

sanskrit: pā̱va̱kā na̱ḥ sara̍svatī̱ vāje̍bhir vā̱jinī̍vatī | ya̱jñaṁ va̍ṣṭu dhi̱yāva̍suḥ ||
english: May Sarasvatī, the purifying one, rich in refreshments and victuals, she who is wealthy in insight — desire our sacrifice.

sanskrit: co̱da̱yi̱trī sū̱nṛtā̍nā̱ṁ ceta̍ntī sumatī̱nām | ya̱jñaṁ da̍dhe̱ sara̍svatī ||
english: Sarasvatī, who impels the truthful words and awakens benevolent thoughts — she upholds the sacrifice.

sanskrit: ma̱ho arṇa̱ḥ sara̍svatī̱ pra ce̍tayati ke̱tunā̍ | dhiyo̱ viśvā̱ vi rā̍jati ||
english: Sarasvatī illumines with her ray the great flood of light; she shines brilliantly over all insights.

sanskrit: su̱rū̱pa̱kṛ̱tnum ū̱taye̍ su̱dughā̍m iva go̱duhe̍ | ju̱hū̱masi̱ dyavi̍-dyavi ||
english: We invoke day by day, for help, Indra who fashions beautiful forms — even as one milks a good milch-cow.

sanskrit: upa̍ na̱ḥ sava̱nā ga̍hi̱ soma̍sya somapāḥ piba | go̱dā id re̱vato̱ mada̍ḥ ||
english: Come to our pressings, O drinker of Soma, and drink the Soma. Truly, that exhilaration grants cows and riches.

sanskrit: athā̍ te̱ anta̍mānāṁ vi̱dyāma̍ sumatī̱nām | mā no̱ ati̍ khya̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: May we know those who are nearest to you, your most gracious intentions. Do not pass us by — come hither.

sanskrit: pare̍hi̱ vigra̱m astṛ̍ta̱m indra̍m pṛcchā vipa̱ścita̍m | yas te̱ sakhi̍bhya̱ ā vara̍m ||
english: Approach Indra the unconquered, the strong one; ask of him who is full of wisdom — he who has the most excellent gift for his friends.

sanskrit: u̱ta bru̍vantu no̱ nido̱ nir a̱nyata̍ś cid ārata | dadhā̍nā̱ indra̱ id duva̍ḥ ||
english: And let our adversaries speak of us only with respect, no matter where they come from — holding Indra alone as their lord.

sanskrit: u̱ta na̍ḥ su̱bhagā̍m̐ a̱rir vo̱ceyu̍r dasma kṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ | syāmed indra̍sya̱ śarma̍ṇi ||
english: And may even the enemy call us fortunate, O marvellous one; may the peoples call us so. May we dwell in Indra's shelter.

sanskrit: em ā̱śum ā̱śave̍ bhara yajña̱śriya̍ṁ nṛ̱māda̍nam | pa̱ta̱yan ma̍nda̱yatsa̍kham ||
english: Come, bring the swift one to the swift, the glory of the sacrifice, the joy of men, the friend who exhilarates as he speeds along.

sanskrit: a̱sya pī̱tvā śa̍takrato gha̱no vṛ̱trāṇā̍m abhavaḥ | prāvo̱ vāje̍ṣu vā̱jina̍m ||
english: Having drunk of this, O Śatakratu, you became the slayer of the Vṛtras; you aided the vigorous one in battles for booty.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̱ vāje̍ṣu vā̱jina̍ṁ vā̱jayā̍maḥ śatakrato | dhanā̍nām indra sā̱taye̍ ||
english: You, O Śatakratu, vigorous in the battles, we impel to victory — O Indra, for the winning of riches.

sanskrit: yo rā̱yo̱3̱̍ 'vani̍r ma̱hān su̍pā̱raḥ su̍nva̱taḥ sakhā̍ | tasmā̱ indrā̍ya gāyata ||
english: Sing to that Indra — who is the great protector of wealth, of easy passage, the friend of the Soma-presser.

sanskrit: ā tv etā̱ ni ṣī̍da̱tendra̍m a̱bhi pra gā̍yata | sakhā̍ya̱ḥ stoma̍vāhasaḥ ||
english: Come, sit down here; sing forth to Indra, O companions who carry the hymns of praise.

sanskrit: pu̱rū̱tama̍m purū̱ṇām īśā̍na̱ṁ vāryā̍ṇām | indra̱ṁ some̱ sacā̍ su̱te ||
english: Indra, the most bountiful of the bountiful, lord of desirable goods — him we honour together with Soma when pressed.

sanskrit: sa ghā̍ no̱ yoga̱ ā bhu̍va̱t sa rā̱ye sa pura̍ṁdhyām | gama̱d vāje̍bhi̱r ā sa na̍ḥ ||
english: May he be present at our yoking, at our wealth, at our full abundance; may he come to us with vigours.

sanskrit: yasya̍ sa̱ṁsthe na vṛ̱ṇvate̱ harī̍ sa̱matsu̱ śatra̍vaḥ | tasmā̱ indrā̍ya gāyata ||
english: Sing to that Indra — in whose presence his two tawny steeds are not restrained even in battles by enemies.

sanskrit: su̱ta̱pāvne̍ su̱tā i̱me śuca̍yo yanti vī̱taye̍ | somā̍so̱ dadhyā̍śiraḥ ||
english: For the drinker of the pressed Soma, these bright juices, pressed and mingled with curds, go forth for his enjoyment.

sanskrit: tvaṁ su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ sa̱dyo vṛ̱ddho a̍jāyathāḥ | indra̱ jyaiṣṭhyā̍ya sukrato ||
english: You, O Indra, grew mighty instantly for the drinking of the pressed Soma — for greatness and supremacy, O Sukratu.

sanskrit: ā tvā̍ viśantv ā̱śava̱ḥ somā̍sa indra girvaṇaḥ | śaṁ te̍ santu̱ prace̍tase ||
english: May the swift Soma-draughts enter into you, O Indra, who art praised by song; may they bring you joy, O wise one.

sanskrit: tvāṁ stomā̍ avīvṛdha̱n tvām u̱kthā śa̍takrato | tvāṁ va̍rdhantu no̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: The hymns of praise have magnified you, the recitations have magnified you, O Śatakratu. May our songs magnify you.

sanskrit: akṣi̍totiḥ saned i̱maṁ vāja̱m indra̍ḥ saha̱sriṇa̍m | yasmi̱n viśvā̍ni̱ pauṁsyā̍ ||
english: Indra, with his inexhaustible aid, shall win this thousandfold booty in which all heroic powers reside.

sanskrit: mā no̱ martā̍ a̱bhi dru̍han ta̱nūnā̍m indra girvaṇaḥ | īśā̍no yavayā va̱dham ||
english: Let no mortal man do harm to our persons, O Indra, praised by songs. As master, ward off the weapon.

sanskrit: yu̱ñjanti̍ bra̱dhnam a̍ru̱ṣaṁ cara̍nta̱m pari̍ ta̱sthuṣa̍ḥ | roca̍nte roca̱nā di̱vi ||
english: They harness the tawny, ruddy one as he moves around those who stand firm; the luminous lights blaze in the sky.

sanskrit: yu̱ñjanty a̍sya̱ kāmyā̱ harī̱ vipa̍kṣasā̱ rathe̍ | śoṇā̍ dhṛ̱ṣṇū nṛ̱vāha̍sā ||
english: They harness his two lovely tawny steeds, wide-winged, to his chariot — the two ruddy, bold ones, the man-carriers.

sanskrit: ke̱tuṁ kṛ̱ṇvann a̍ke̱tave̱ peśo̍ maryā ape̱śase̍ | sam u̱ṣadbhi̍r ajāyathāḥ ||
english: Making a beacon for the beaconless, form for the formless, O hero — you were born together with the dawns.

sanskrit: ād aha̍ sva̱dhām anu̱ puna̍r garbha̱tvam e̍ri̱re | dadhā̍nā̱ nāma̍ ya̱jñiya̍m ||
english: Then, following their inherent power, they were set in motion toward renewed germination — bearing the name worthy of sacrifice.

sanskrit: vī̱ḻu ci̍d āruja̱tnubhi̱r guhā̍ cid indra̱ vahni̍bhiḥ | avi̍nda u̱sriyā̱ anu̍ ||
english: Even what was hard to break you split, even what was hidden, O Indra, with your carriers; you found the cows that were in the cave.

sanskrit: de̱va̱yanto̱ yathā̍ ma̱tim acchā̍ vi̱dadva̍su̱ṁ gira̍ḥ | ma̱hām a̍nūṣata śru̱tam ||
english: As those who worship the gods send their hymns toward the one who discovers wealth — so have they sung of the great, far-famed one.

sanskrit: indre̍ṇa̱ saṁ hi dṛkṣa̍se saṁjagmā̱no abi̍bhyuṣā | ma̱ndū sa̍mā̱nava̍rcasā ||
english: For you are seen together with Indra — united, without fear, both exhilarating and of equal glory.

sanskrit: a̱na̱va̱dyair a̱bhidyu̍bhir ma̱khaḥ saha̍svad arcati | ga̱ṇair indra̍sya̱ kāmyai̍ḥ ||
english: The liberal one sings brilliantly with his blameless, heavenly ones, with the lovely troops of Indra.

sanskrit: ata̍ḥ parijma̱nn ā ga̍hi di̱vo vā̍ roca̱nād adhi̍ | sam a̍sminn ṛñjate̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: Come hither, O all-pervading one, from this place or from the shining vault of heaven. The hymns meet in him.

sanskrit: i̱to vā̍ sā̱tim īma̍he di̱vo vā̱ pārthi̍vā̱d adhi̍ | indra̍m ma̱ho vā̱ raja̍saḥ ||
english: From here or from the heaven or from the earthly realm, or from the vast expanse — we implore Indra for his bounty.

sanskrit: indra̱m id gā̱thino̍ bṛ̱had indra̍m a̱rkebhi̍r a̱rkiṇa̍ḥ | indra̱ṁ vāṇī̍r anūṣata ||
english: The singers with their great songs, the chanters with their chants, the melodists with their melodies — all have sung of Indra.

sanskrit: indra̱ id dharyo̱ḥ sacā̱ sammi̍śla̱ ā va̍co̱yujā̍ | indro̍ va̱jrī hi̍ra̱ṇyaya̍ḥ ||
english: Indra is together with his two tawny steeds, yoked by the word, all-commingled. Indra wields the vajra and is golden.

sanskrit: indro̍ dī̱rghāya̱ cakṣa̍sa̱ ā sūrya̍ṁ rohayad di̱vi | vi gobhi̱r adri̍m airayat ||
english: For far-reaching sight, Indra set the sun to rise in the sky; he released the light-cows from the rock.

sanskrit: indra̱ vāje̍ṣu no 'va sa̱hasra̍pradhaneṣu ca | u̱gra u̱grābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, protect us in the battles and in the contests for a thousandfold prize — O mighty one, with your mighty aids.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ va̱yam ma̍hādha̱na indra̱m arbhe̍ havāmahe | yuja̍ṁ vṛ̱treṣu̍ va̱jriṇa̍m ||
english: We invoke Indra in the great prize-contest and in the small — the vajra-wielder as our ally in the battles against Vṛtras.

sanskrit: sa no̍ vṛṣann a̱muṁ ca̱ruṁ satrā̍dāva̱nn apā̍ vṛdhi | a̱smabhya̱m apra̍tiṣkutaḥ ||
english: O mighty bull, give us that beautiful offering; grant it completely, the all-giver who is never thwarted.

sanskrit: tu̱ñje-tu̍ñje̱ ya utta̍re̱ stomā̱ indra̍sya va̱jriṇa̍ḥ | na vi̍ndhe asya suṣṭu̱tim ||
english: At each pressing after pressing, the praises of Indra the vajra-wielder grow greater; I find no end to his laudation.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̍ yū̱theva̱ vaṁsa̍gaḥ kṛ̱ṣṭīr i̍ya̱rty oja̍sā | īśā̍no̱ apra̍tiṣkutaḥ ||
english: Like a bull leading the herd to the stall, he sets the peoples in motion by his power — the lord, who is never thwarted.

sanskrit: ya eka̍ś carṣaṇī̱nāṁ vasū̍nām ira̱jyati̍ | indra̱ḥ pañca̍ kṣitī̱nām ||
english: He who alone rules over men and over riches — Indra, lord of the five peoples.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ vo vi̱śvata̱s pari̱ havā̍mahe̱ jane̍bhyaḥ | a̱smāka̍m astu̱ keva̍laḥ ||
english: We invoke Indra from all sides, beyond all peoples; may he be ours alone.

sanskrit: endra̍ sāna̱siṁ ra̱yiṁ sa̱jitvā̍naṁ sadā̱saha̍m | varṣi̍ṣṭham ū̱taye̍ bhara ||
english: O Indra, bring us wealth that wins, that ever conquers, ever prevails — the most excellent wealth for our aid.

sanskrit: ni yena̍ muṣṭiha̱tyayā̱ ni vṛ̱trā ru̱ṇadhā̍mahai | tvotā̍so̱ ny arva̍tā ||
english: By which, with a fist-blow, we may utterly check the Vṛtras — we who are aided by you, with your chariot-horse.

sanskrit: indra̱ tvotā̍sa̱ ā va̱yaṁ vajra̍ṁ gha̱nā da̍dīmahi | jaye̍ma̱ saṁ yu̱dhi spṛdha̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra, aided by you, we would take the vajra as a weapon of smiting; may we conquer our rivals in battle.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ śūre̍bhi̱r astṛ̍bhi̱r indra̱ tvayā̍ yu̱jā va̱yam | sā̱sa̱hyāma̍ pṛtanya̱taḥ ||
english: We, with our heroic archers, with you, O Indra, as our ally — we would overpower those who strive against us in battle.

sanskrit: ma̱hām̐ indra̍ḥ pa̱raś ca̱ nu ma̍hi̱tvam a̍stu va̱jriṇe̍ | dyaur na pra̍thi̱nā śava̍ḥ ||
english: Great is Indra now and beyond, and great let his greatness be for the vajra-wielder — his power as broad as the sky.

sanskrit: sa̱mo̱he vā̱ ya āśa̍ta̱ nara̍s to̱kasya̱ sani̍tau | viprā̍so vā dhiyā̱yava̍ḥ ||
english: Whether in battle or in the gaining of offspring, those heroes who are inspired and intent on prayer — they attain him.

sanskrit: yaḥ ku̱kṣiḥ so̍ma̱pāta̍maḥ samu̱dra i̍va̱ pinva̍te | u̱rvīr āpo̱ na kā̱kuda̍ḥ ||
english: His belly, which contains the most Soma, swells like the ocean — like the broad waters at their crest.

sanskrit: e̱vā hy a̍sya sū̱nṛtā̍ vira̱pśī goma̍tī ma̱hī | pa̱kvā śākhā̱ na dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: For such is his bounty, joyful, mighty, rich in cows — like a ripe branch bending down to the worshipper.

sanskrit: e̱vā hi te̱ vibhū̍taya ū̱taya̍ indra̱ māva̍te | sa̱dyaś ci̱t santi̍ dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: For thus, O Indra, your manifold aids are present even now, immediately, for me your devoted worshipper.

sanskrit: e̱vā hy a̍sya̱ kāmyā̱ stoma̍ u̱kthaṁ ca̱ śaṁsyā̍ | indrā̍ya̱ soma̍pītaye ||
english: For such is his desirable hymn of praise and the recitation worthy to be proclaimed — for Indra, for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: indrehi̱ matsy andha̍so̱ viśve̍bhiḥ soma̱parva̍bhiḥ | ma̱hām̐ a̍bhi̱ṣṭir oja̍sā ||
english: Come, O Indra, rejoice in the Soma-drink with all its Soma-portions; the great invocatory power comes to you with might.

sanskrit: em e̍naṁ sṛjatā su̱te ma̱ndim indrā̍ya ma̱ndine̍ | cakri̱ṁ viśvā̍ni̱ cakra̍ye ||
english: Release him — the exhilarating one — toward Indra at the pressing, for Indra who delights in exhilaration, the performer of all deeds.

sanskrit: matsvā̍ suśipra ma̱ndibhi̱ḥ stome̍bhir viśvacarṣaṇe | sacai̱ṣu sava̍ne̱ṣv ā ||
english: Be exhilarated, O fair-jawed one, by the exhilarating praises, O you who look upon all men; be present at these pressings.

sanskrit: asṛ̍gram indra te̱ gira̱ḥ prati̱ tvām ud a̍hāsata | ajo̍ṣā vṛṣa̱bham pati̍m ||
english: They have poured forth your praises, O Indra; they have raised themselves up toward you — eagerly, toward the bull-lord.

sanskrit: saṁ co̍daya ci̱tram a̱rvāg rādha̍ indra̱ vare̍ṇyam | asa̱d it te̍ vi̱bhu pra̱bhu ||
english: Stir hither toward us a wondrous, excellent bounty, O Indra; may it be yours, pervasive and mighty.

sanskrit: a̱smān su tatra̍ coda̱yendra̍ rā̱ye rabha̍svataḥ | tuvi̍dyumna̱ yaśa̍svataḥ ||
english: O Indra, of great brilliance, of great fame — impel us there, toward wealth, toward the eager and the glorious.

sanskrit: saṁ goma̍d indra̱ vāja̍vad a̱sme pṛ̱thu śravo̍ bṛ̱hat | vi̱śvāyu̍r dhe̱hy akṣi̍tam ||
english: O Indra, grant us broad, mighty fame together with cows and vigour — lasting for all ages, inexhaustible.

sanskrit: a̱sme dhe̍hi̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱had dyu̱mnaṁ sa̍hasra̱sāta̍mam | indra̱ tā ra̱thinī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: Grant us great fame, O Indra, and the brilliance most fruitful of thousands — and those chariot-borne refreshments.

sanskrit: vaso̱r indra̱ṁ vasu̍patiṁ gī̱rbhir gṛ̱ṇanta̍ ṛ̱gmiya̍m | homa̱ gantā̍ram ū̱taye̍ ||
english: Let us praise with songs Indra, lord of goods, master of riches, worthy of the Ṛgveda-hymns — the one who comes to offer his aid.

sanskrit: su̱te-su̍te̱ nyo̍kase bṛ̱had bṛ̍ha̱ta ed a̱riḥ | indrā̍ya śū̱ṣam a̍rcati ||
english: At each and every pressing, the praiser who abides at home sings for Indra a great, great song of heroic power.

sanskrit: gāya̍nti tvā gāya̱triṇo 'rca̍nty a̱rkam a̱rkiṇa̍ḥ | bra̱hmāṇa̍s tvā śatakrata̱ ud va̱ṁśam i̍va yemire ||
english: The Gāyatrī-singers sing to you; the Arka-chanters hymn the Arka to you; the Brāhmaṇas, O Śatakratu, have raised you up like a bamboo pole.

sanskrit: yat sāno̱ḥ sānu̱m āru̍ha̱d bhūry aspa̍ṣṭa̱ kartva̍m | tad indro̱ artha̍ṁ cetati yū̱thena̍ vṛ̱ṣṇir e̍jati ||
english: As he climbs from ridge to ridge, discerning the many deeds to be done — Indra perceives the purpose and goes forth with his troop, the bull.

sanskrit: yu̱kṣvā hi ke̱śinā̱ harī̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā kakṣya̱prā | athā̍ na indra somapā gi̱rām upa̍śrutiṁ cara ||
english: Harness your two maned, tawny stallions, vigorous, filling the girth-strap; then come, O Indra, drinker of Soma, within hearing of our songs.

sanskrit: ehi̱ stomā̍m̐ a̱bhi sva̍rā̱bhi gṛ̍ṇī̱hy ā ru̍va | brahma̍ ca no vaso̱ sacendra̍ ya̱jñaṁ ca̍ vardhaya ||
english: Come, resound toward the praises, roar forth toward us; attend to our sacred utterance, O Indra, O master, and strengthen our sacrifice.

sanskrit: u̱ktham indrā̍ya̱ śaṁsya̱ṁ vardha̍nam puruni̱ṣṣidhe̍ | śa̱kro yathā̍ su̱teṣu̍ ṇo rā̱raṇa̍t sa̱khyeṣu̍ ca ||
english: A recitation praiseworthy and magnifying for Indra who dwells in many places — so that Śakra may rejoice in our pressings and in our friendships.

sanskrit: tam it sa̍khi̱tva ī̍mahe̱ taṁ rā̱ye taṁ su̱vīrye̍ | sa śa̱kra u̱ta na̍ḥ śaka̱d indro̱ vasu̱ daya̍mānaḥ ||
english: Him we implore for friendship, him for wealth, him for valour of heroes; may Śakra — and Indra while sharing his riches — be able to help us.

sanskrit: su̱vi̱vṛta̍ṁ suni̱raja̱m indra̱ tvādā̍ta̱m id yaśa̍ḥ | gavā̱m apa̍ vra̱jaṁ vṛ̍dhi kṛṇu̱ṣva rādho̍ adrivaḥ ||
english: Well-spread and well-brightened — truly the glory given by you, O Indra; open the stall of the cows; O boulder-wielder, bestow your bounty.

sanskrit: na̱hi tvā̱ roda̍sī u̱bhe ṛ̍ghā̱yamā̍ṇa̱m inva̍taḥ | jeṣa̱ḥ sva̍rvatīr a̱paḥ saṁ gā a̱smabhya̍ṁ dhūnuhi ||
english: Neither of the two worlds can constrain you as you thunder; win the sun-bright waters; shake the cows together for us.

sanskrit: āśru̍tkarṇa śru̱dhī hava̱ṁ nū ci̍d dadhiṣva me̱ gira̍ḥ | indra̱ stoma̍m i̱mam mama̍ kṛ̱ṣvā yu̱jaś ci̱d anta̍ram ||
english: O you whose ears listen to our cry — hear now my invocation; receive my songs, O Indra; make this my hymn the most intimate of allies.

sanskrit: vi̱dmā hi tvā̱ vṛṣa̍ntama̱ṁ vāje̍ṣu havana̱śruta̍m | vṛṣa̍ntamasya hūmaha ū̱tiṁ sa̍hasra̱sāta̍mām ||
english: For we know you as the most virile bull in the battles, heard when invoked; of this most virile one we implore the aid most fruitful of thousands.

sanskrit: ā tū na̍ indra kauśika mandasā̱naḥ su̱tam pi̍ba | navya̱m āyu̱ḥ pra sū ti̍ra kṛ̱dhī sa̍hasra̱sām ṛṣi̍m ||
english: Come now, O Indra of the Kuśika clan, exhilarated, and drink the pressed Soma; prolong a new life for us; make the seer win a thousandfold.

sanskrit: pari̍ tvā girvaṇo̱ gira̍ i̱mā bha̍vantu vi̱śvata̍ḥ | vṛ̱ddhāyu̱m anu̱ vṛddha̍yo̱ juṣṭā̍ bhavantu̱ juṣṭa̍yaḥ ||
english: May these songs encompass you on all sides, O lover of praise; as the grown ones follow the elder, may the beloved praises be pleasing.
